title: Encouraging positivity in the workplace
excerpt: AMCOB promotes positivity in the workplace to enhance teamwork, motivation, and overall employee satisfaction and success.
lead: AMCOB promotes positivity in the workplace to enhance teamwork, motivation, and overall employee satisfaction and success.
richHtml:
The workplace environment is directly proportional to employees’ behavior towards their co-workers and the clients which also influences their performance, engagement, and motivation level. if the workplace environment is toxic, it is impossible for the employees to perform using their full potential. If the work culture is positive, productivity will be high.

Work culture is the non-tangible force that surrounds us all the time and helps to drive performance and lead to satisfaction level of the employees. Having a positive work culture results in teamwork, increased employee morale and employee efficiency leading to more productivity. It also helps to retain employees in the organization.

An authentic organizational culture should reflect upon the values and goals of the organization. It’s a powerful force which helps the employees to make better decisions, perform the right actions at the right time and improve their performance.

Importance of a positive workplace environment

It is important to have a strong and positive workplace environment as it defines the organization’s internal and external individuality. It is capable of strongly influencing the employee’s performance which also derives the employee turnover.

There are some basic ways that the organization should follow to surround the organization with a positive work environment:

Encourage association and communication

Organizations that believe in open communication and teamwork are more successful at creating a positive workplace environment. Employers should provide opportunities to the employees in terms of raising their voice to make their opinions heard. This will give them a platform for social engagement and interaction which goes a long way in developing a sense of belonging and leadership among employees.

Strong connection allows to nurture connection and trust among employees. It is essential to have good communication and understanding among management and the employees to work for the company’s goals together. Expectations should be made crystal clear for both the parties so that the communication is smooth. It positively impacts the organizational culture also.

Appreciating and acknowledging employees

As an organization, you should value and celebrate your people. It does wonders in terms of productivity, motivation, and engagement.

Companies should give out various rewards and certificates to appreciate the smallest of the efforts as well. They can even create a rewards committee which will look after all the employees who are performing well in the organization. There should be awards other than the regular annual ones. Bonuses should be given for outstanding ideas and significant contributions made for the organization.

This also promotes a healthy competition in the organization among employees as they try to achieve these rewards and recognition. This helps to create a very positive environment in the organization.

Incorporate diversity

Organizations which promote diverse and inclusive workforce tend to perform much better than their competitors. It leads to greater proficiency, a very healthy work culture and more satisfied employees.

A sign of a positive work environment is where all employees are equally appreciated, accepted, respected, supported, and nurtured. There are no biases in any form irrespective of gender, color, or background.

This makes the employees happy and comfortable at work promoting a positive workplace environment. Organizations should work towards building a safe and healthy work environment which promotes diversity.

Provide opportunities for development of employees

Organizations should provide their employees with various opportunities to grow personally and professionally as well. Working on people development is very vital for organizations as it leads to employee well-being and productive work culture. Employee retention can also be boosted by encouraging employees to grow.

When employers invest their time and energy in their people, the staff also realizes the effort and tends to work harder to prove themselves worthy of all the efforts that the company is investing in them.

Offering different training allowances or sponsoring various learning courses and certifications are some common ways through which employers can help to build and sustain a positive and dynamic work environment.

Make work enjoyable

Routine work may get very tiring for the employees and drain their energy. Therefore, employers should find various ways to make work fun for them. ‘Fun’ here means happier teams and happier staff. Conducting various activities at work can build trust among employees and enhance teamwork.

Hosting various events and retreat allows employees to come closer and have a more positive work environment. Companies should make efforts in creating a healthy work environment where employees feel safe and happy to work.

A positive workplace environment is crucial towards the company’s success and productivity ratio. It is important for leaders to instill a sense of belonging and pride among their teams. When employees are proud of being associated with the company, they align themselves with the company’s vision, they work hard to solve problems and increase productivity eventually. Positive work environment boosts employee engagement at all levels, making the company a better place for its employees.

title: Be careful of what you watch online
excerpt: AMCOB reminds you to be mindful of what you watch online, protect your focus, values, and digital well-being.
lead: AMCOB reminds you to be mindful of what you watch online, protect your focus, values, and digital well-being.
richHtml:
We unintentionally click on different ads while scrolling social media without realizing what they are. This is termed as content marketing.

Various advertisements have disguised content. Usage of different funny memes, inspiring stories of people have much more meaning than what the ad is showing. Such advertisements promote positive and good emotions in the consumers. It convinces them to buy the product based on the emotion they are reflecting in the advertisement. The mixture of content marketing and social media together, is very powerful. If the product which they are selling is of addictive nature, it becomes very dangerous for the audience. The impact caused on the audience can be alarming.

Least engagement

If a brand can successfully create a positive emotional connection with its audience, they don’t require a lot of effort to make sales. Positive connect with the audience derives more sales. In fact, hard sales and direct call to action will do the opposite over here. It results in consumers constructing increased mental fortifications once they realize what they are being sold.

To diminish its impact, ads of content marketing are designed to trigger less cognitive engagement. In fact, this makes the audience giggle. Through this, a brand can change its image from market crier to a friendly brand. This technique in today’s world helps to gain social media followers. As the audience likes and comments on the post, it gains drive which is a holy grail for the marketers. Using correct humor will gauge audience attention.

Psychological fortifications

Brands vary according to what they sell, some sell meat and at the same time some are selling addictive products. For such brands content marketing is very important to cover the main motive behind what they are selling. Content marketing is used as a shield to hide the addictive nature of the product. There is one target audience for whom the effects can be very dangerous.

It is for kids under 25. Including children who are below 16, they get affected the most. As they tend to like, share, and comment on these posts the most. Children have less skills to identify the intensity of an ad like adults do. At this age, the curiosity to explore is the most and it gives children the direction to navigate things which they shouldn’t.

When presented with content marketing, it is difficult for children to identify the intent of the post. They are easily persuaded to purchase the product and explore more through the given links.

For example, gambling content marketing is much more appealing because of its addictive nature to all age groups. This makes it more serious that the authority responsible for advertising standards won’t control content marketing, it only controls where there is a specific mention of the product and service making consumers turn off.

It is important to wisely scroll social media, but all that glitter is not gold. It may lead to some addictions and wrong consumption of products which might have a long-run impact on the personality and development of human beings.

title: What creativity can be defined as in today’s world?
excerpt: AMCOB defines creativity as the power to innovate, adapt, and bring fresh ideas that drive success in today’s fast-changing world.
lead: AMCOB defines creativity as the power to innovate, adapt, and bring fresh ideas that drive success in today’s fast-changing world.
richHtml:
What is that aspect which makes marketing creative? More ground-breaking and inventive? Usually, creative marketing is linked with colorful pictures and words which go hand in hand with the brand’s image. It may seem simple but marketing is very multifaceted and demanding. A good marketer needs to master data analytics, the design of the product and most importantly, customer experience. Because this is what brings back your loyal customers to the outlet again.

Marketing is more about providing customers with the best experience so that they come back for more. Marketing trends have been evolving drastically and no one technique is enough for a brand. Several techniques and trends are used to make the product/service stand out among the rest. There are few important aspects that have helped companies to do better in terms of marketing.

Create the product with the customer, not just typically for the customer. It is generally said that all marketing trends and efforts should be customer centric, but today’s customer is not just your regular customer. In this era of marketing, customers are also creators of products who can develop different content and ideas for you. Taking customers' opinions in developing what they need can ensure people are going to take your product seriously. Local apps collect data, displaying customer preferences and letting the company know what the best for their target audience is.

Investing in end-to-end customer experience will help the company know their customers inside out. An expert marketer will divert its entire focus on making the experience of visiting the outlet, shopping the product and after sales service ultimately the best experience for the customers. This relationship is made over time and requires consistent efforts. It requires creative thinking to solve the problems of the customers. The digital experience of the customers becomes the key-differentiator. Various membership programs are offered by companies to make sure the customer experience is rich and satisfying. It should be good enough for any customer to come back and shop more.

Customers and employees should be turned into your advocates as word of mouth is something which people still believe in every time over what they see in advertisements. Awareness and reputation are never achieved through PR and paid media. Instead, it can be greatly achieved through making your customers and employees advocate for your product and service. People have become the new channel to ensure reputation in the market. The best way to amplify this is through inspiring creativity in others. Companies should treat everyone as an extension of the marketing team: your stakeholders, employees, and customers. Making your employees feel good reflects in what they speak with others about you. This impact is very long lasting. Some employees are not even confident talking about their company’s story which shows their dissatisfaction for the company.

Creativity should be measured numerically because then only you will be able to know what is working best for the company. This helps marketing measure and manage itself in new ways. It is all about finding value of your business in various new ways. Many companies use online dashboards to access and track performance of the organization. This analysis can be done across various digital initiatives, geographies, and channels. As a result of this, you can quickly allocate and reallocate resources towards achieving efficiency and results. Some companies use value management software to keep track of the performance and value generated through it. This way employees are also accountable for measurable and specific results.

Most importantly, you need to have things clear in your mind first. Your thought process should be like a startup company. In today’s time, marketers need to think like entrepreneurs and should thrive to adjust and sustain the product to be market fit. Marketers have adopted the method of supple development, where customer testing is there to ensure what the target audience wants to experience in a product.

The drastic changes happening in customer thinking and technology development is redefining the nature of marketing creativity. Media is also helping to redefine these parameters greatly. Hence, the techniques to capture audience attention must be advanced too. The measure of marketing success does not rely on the input now, or how well a campaign has run, in fact it is rather the value of the output which advocates the success of the marketing. Today’s marketers need to push their boundaries and think like innovators and entrepreneurs, working on value maximization and the entire customer experience to achieve results.

title: Why should the customers buy from you?
excerpt: AMCOB explains how to define your unique value so customers choose you with trust, quality, and meaningful brand connection.
lead: AMCOB explains how to define your unique value so customers choose you with trust, quality, and meaningful brand connection.
richHtml:
What is that special power that attracts the customer towards your brand? What encourages people to choose your brand over many alternatives available in the market? What makes your company better than the rest? The answer is the value proposition of your company.

If you can master the art of value proposition, you can convert many customers to potential and long-term customers. Delivering the value of your product and services in a compelling way to your customers is the most challenging part. Once you know how to take your business game to the next level, your customers will always come back to you.

What is a value proposition?

It’s a value that the company promises to deliver to its customers through their products and services after post purchase. It is what makes the product striking for the customers and satisfies them.

An effective value proposition has the following attributes:

  • It is very specific in terms of the benefit that will be offered to the target market.
  • It clearly describes how the product can fulfill the needs of the customer or fix the problem.
  • It talks about how the product is different from the market and better than the rest of the alternatives.

Your value proposition of the company should focus on how your product and services are providing the best possible solution for the problems that the customers are facing. The value proposition is how the lives of the customers are positively impacted by your product or service and makes them trust the brand.

A value proposition should be clear, visible and efficiently delivered to the customers. When the customer enters the shop or visits any social media handle of the company, the value proposition should be clearly expressed, delivered and repeated for the customers. It shouldn’t be written on the corner of the website, this won’t help the company get sales. The value proposition should be bold, clear, visible and well comprehended for the customers.

How to create an impactful value proposition?

  • Listen to your customer’s voice. You can use the exact words of your customers in order to gain more customers for the future. You can interview them and ask them about how they would describe the product and the reason for their association with the brand. You can even send out some survey forms to know better about their point of view. Listen to what they have to say, pay attention to common words and use it smartly as your value proposition.
  • Your value proposition should be crystal clear and serve all purposes. Before forming the value proposition, the company should do its homework and answer some important questions. They can be, what product are you selling, who should buy your product, why should they buy your product, what makes you different from the rest, how will your product improve the life of your customer and when exactly will the value of your product be delivered?
  • Your value proposition should be short, crisp and precise.
  • Focus on the benefits that your product will offer to the customers.

Your value proposition is a promise that the company makes to its customers in order to achieve their trust and long-term association with the brand. If the promise is specific, well delivered and focused, your customers will always stay loyal to your product and services. They will even generate positive word of mouth for your company and spread good word about it. Communicating the value to the customers and living up to their expectations is very essential. It is a marketing workout which will pay you again and again with a multiplying effect.

title: Role of HR in telecommuted recruitment
excerpt: AMCOB explores the vital role of HR in telecommuted recruitment, ensuring efficient hiring and remote workforce integration.
lead: AMCOB explores the vital role of HR in telecommuted recruitment, ensuring efficient hiring and remote workforce integration.
richHtml:
As the pandemic hit the world and everyone was bound to stay at home, The Human Resource department developed a key role in remote recruitment, providing various companies legal services and virtual on-boarding strategies for the new recruitment.

As the name says, the Human Resource department deals with human capital and works towards placing the right person at the right place. They find the best fit for the organization in compliance to the organizational environment and work expectations. HR supports the recruitment process with various strategies.

In telecommuted recruitment, the basic role of HR is to provide support from team building strategies to compact training programs for the employees that are hired.

HR is very crucial for the company as they are the ones who find the best fit people for the company otherwise inefficiency of wrong hiring can result into monetary loss.

Importance of HR in telecommuted recruitment

Enumerating the role of human resource related happenings can be perplexing for the company but it is not impossible.

Here automated HR software can be handy and can prove to be very beneficial. Recruiters nowadays believe that the market is dominated as a candidate driven market. In the next few years, it is observed that HR departments will be investing in predictive examination, process mechanization and artificial intellect for the hiring methods.

In recent years, ‘culture fit’ has become a crucial factor for selecting candidates. It is because if the person is not able to adapt to the culture of the organization, they can prove to be very toxic for the organization. Companies can afford a less trained employee as they can be trained later, but they can’t afford hiring a stubborn and self-centered employee.

Activities that support telecommuted recruitment

  1. Compensation and reimbursements: Usually companies comprise of people working from different cities and countries. When a job ad is posted, HR teams can assist in setting a fair compensation which justifies the competencies of the employee and local living costs. Some organizations also rely on their HR department for payroll and increase in salary. Telecommuted HR is treasured when you have to hire candidates from different countries. It also reduces the hiring time since the induction is done remotely.
  2. Training and development: Having skilled and talented employees also help the company to win by giving the company an edge over its competitors. Training and development is an important factor of telecommuted recruitment as depending on the type of candidate, the HR department provides various training to support the skill set of the candidates making the work operations smooth. It is very helpful in producing better results for the company.
  3. Lawful compliance: Hiring in various geographical areas involve various legal acknowledgements and labor laws. After these difficult times, the government is also cooperating with pandemic restrictions related to remote work. HR compliance identifies the favorable areas to hire candidates where the legal issues can be avoided.
  4. Workplace protection: Remote HR teams are a respected asset when it comes to creating a safe and constructive remote atmosphere as no employee wants to feel discriminated against and endangered at their workplace. An efficient team can develop a healthy work environment keeping in mind the company’s goals and nature of work.
  5. Virtual hiring and team building: HR teams support management level employees to hire people virtually and form a strong team. Sometimes, working virtually can make you feel demotivated and isolated but the HR department works on the best strategies to keep the employees engaged and motivated.

Hiring new candidates is challenging but telecommuted recruitment has set some new rules for this game. To remain competitive in the market and attract the right fit for your organization, updating the strategies is constantly required. This is why HR teams are constantly at work to get more skilled in providing the best strategies. Enthusiastic and hardworking HR departments can help the companies find proficient and hardworking talent.

title: Recognition is the greatest encouragement to boost employee well-being
excerpt: AMCOB emphasizes how recognition strengthens employee well-being, motivation, and loyalty, creating a positive workplace culture.
lead: AMCOB emphasizes how recognition strengthens employee well-being, motivation, and loyalty, creating a positive workplace culture.
richHtml:
Tangible acknowledgement will help employers to increase the stay of their employees in the company. This shows how important it is to appreciate your employees for their efforts and dedication.

What is employee recognition?

It is showing gratitude towards your employees to acknowledge their hard work, dedication and honesty that they put in their work to achieve organization goals. It is also to support the organization’s aims of making the organization a better work place for the employees.

Every employee is entitled to receive salary and other perks and benefits from the organization but if they lack appreciation, there are high chances of them feeling demotivated. This is why employees should be recognized and acknowledged.

  • As human beings, we always seek validation and appreciation at every step. Recognizing employee efforts will help the employee bond with the company emotionally which will lead to increase in productivity.
  • Some employees love taking challenges and seek reward for them to keep achieving better. These tasks help to improve a person's skills and abilities. Appreciation helps them to fulfill great challenges.
  • As a part of the community, employees reflect the company’s values in the society as well. If the company is positive and appreciative towards the employees, the same values will prevail in the society.

Small efforts from the company’s end will give a sense of belonging to the employees. Through following ways, you can appreciate your employees well.

  • Companies should focus on the well-being of employees and make sure they provide medical assistance to them and their family members. The general vaccination costs can be covered by the company to make employees feel that the organization considers them as a family.
  • Companies can offer various skill development and leadership courses to boost the level of confidence among the employees and prepare them for bigger and strategic roles in the organization. When the organization provides a career path to its employees, their self-esteem becomes very high and they are very motivated to perform the best they can.
  • Some big companies offer the facility of gym, pool, laundry, salon and even hospital to their employees so that they can release their stress and feel relaxed. A naturally relaxed body and mind produce better results at work.
  • Companies should recognize the efforts of their well-performing employees in front of their peers and other organization members to boost their confidence and self-esteem. The company can provide them certificates, shields, or even trophies to acknowledge their hard work. The management level employees can make this a daily practice to recognize small efforts of their teammates to keep them motivated to achieve the best.
  • The bosses can have lunch with their team once in a while or plan recreational trips to make them feel connected with each other and talk about common interests. This will keep the employee happy and motivated towards work.
  • The achievers' names should be written on the wall of fame giving everyone a motivation to work harder and show maximum effort. This will give them a different kind of energy to work hard and get their name and picture also engraved on the wall of fame.
  • High achievers can be given special facilities for a specific time period to keep them motivated for working hard.
  • Rewards should be given at the right time. If the critical task is achieved on time with 100% efficiency, then the employee should be given reward and appreciation so that they can continue with the same performance.
  • Celebrating birthdays and special events of the employees’ life in the office will give them a sense of belonging towards the organization.

Employees are the first ones that an organization should take care of. Happy employees take care of the clients and generate the same energy in them.

title: Importance of Employee Referral Programs
excerpt: AMCOB highlights the importance of employee referral programs in finding quality talent, boosting engagement, and saving hiring costs.
lead: AMCOB highlights the importance of employee referral programs in finding quality talent, boosting engagement, and saving hiring costs.
richHtml:
Employee referral program is the most trusted method of recruiting employees used by many companies.

What are Employee Referral Programs?

It is one of the most efficient and reliable ways of hiring the right candidate. It is generally seen that employees hired via referrals have a much better recruitment rate which precisely means that they have more chances of getting selected than other candidates who are applying for the same position. The reason for which companies rely on this method is the greater employee retention which is achieved through this method. These referral based employees tend to stay in the organization for a longer time period and it automatically reduces the cost of hiring. These candidates are more flexible when it comes to adjusting in the organization and getting familiar with the organizational culture. This is because the employee who referred them has their image on stake so these referred employees perform well to prove that they are the best fit for the organization. This is more of a win-win situation for the company and the referred employee as it benefits both the parties.

How does an Employee Referral Program work?

A few set of instructions should be followed formally to get the best results from the Employee Referral Program which are as following:

  • Provide the candidates with formal training according to the employee referral policy. Train them for their job, educate them about the software used in the organization. Explain them about the benefits of the referred employee and how their good performance can be beneficial both for the company and themselves.
  • All employees should be updated via email regarding the opening of positions and various job vacancies within the organization.
  • Referral process should be kept very simplified and basic. It should be easy to understand for all levels of employees so that the right person can be hired.
  • The Job description should be well-designed with simpler terminologies so that it is easier to understand. It will help the employee understand the exact nature of work and the skill set which is required.
  • Once an employee has referred a candidate, it is HR’s job to involve the employee in all sorts of communication which is relevant to them. This way important communication with the candidate can also be done via them regarding specific timelines and what to expect from the company.
  • Send a thank you email or acknowledge them for referring to an efficient candidate.

How Employee Referral can prove to be the best way of hiring?

This can be a very good source of hiring the right candidate. Following are the reasons:

  • By involving employees in referral based hiring, it encourages the employees to think for the better future of the organization. It makes them feel good about their company as their referred employee is taken into consideration for hiring.
  • New hiring done through referrals prove to be more efficient and can increase profit for the organization. Current employees are familiar with the organization culture and the skill set required to work hence they refer to the right candidate who can adjust in the same environment and have the right potential to take pressure and produce results.
  • This produces a positive organizational culture as the current employees are well aware about the organization’s culture, values and objectives and they refer to the same type of employees who can gel in within the company.
  • There are several bonuses and perks given under the Employee Referral Program which encourages the employees to find the best fit for the organization. The employees also feel motivated as monetary benefits are attached to this program.
  • Employee Referral programs reduce the time of hiring and saves cost for the organization.
  • Companies can offer a bonus or prize to the department which gives the most referrals. It can prove to be a healthy competition.

It is generally considered as a very healthy way of hiring employees for the organization who work to achieve the goals and objectives of the company.

title: How to outshine in your interview
excerpt: AMCOB offers expert tips to help you outshine in your interview with confidence, preparation, and professional impact.
lead: AMCOB offers expert tips to help you outshine in your interview with confidence, preparation, and professional impact.
richHtml:
When candidates are searching jobs and applying in different companies, they should be thoroughly prepared for some basic questions that will set them apart from the rest of the candidates. Answering those questions correctly and with confidence is the key. No employee comes 100% trained for the job, what employer seeks is the right type of attitude in the potential candidate and their flexibility to adjust in the environment to learn and comprehend things.

These are some questions which are asked very commonly and the whole judgement of the candidate usually depends on this only:

  • Introduce yourself to us 

Most of the interviews start from this question, through which the interviewer judges the confidence level of the candidate. So one shouldn’t stumble while answering this and tell about their educational background and hobbies. Mentioning about your goal in life or curiosity to learn more things should be added to create an impression on the interviewer.

  • Why do you want to work in this particular organization

By asking this question, the interviewer analyzes how well the candidate has done their homework in knowing about the company through their official website or contacts. They want to know how passionate the candidate is to work for the company. At this point, you can even ask the interviewer questions related to the company to show your eagerness towards knowing the company better.

  • How do you came across this job

Such questions don’t require the candidate to tell the source of the job, in fact these questions focus more on how well the candidate knows about the company. Candidates can answer in a way which will show their eagerness to work with the company and what motivates them the best about this company.

  • Share something about your resume

When these questions are asked, the interviewer wants to know about those achievements of the candidate which are most important and something they are very proud of. It can be related to any field so candidate can talk in detail about it.

  • Why are you searching for a job

This question helps the interviewer to filter answers from the candidate about their previous job, what was the reason for leaving it or if they were fired. They also want to know the future work plans of the candidate.

  • Why should the company hire you

When this question is asked, the candidate must keep in their mind that the interviewer wants to hear about those achievements of the candidate which can prove beneficial for the company. They can mention all those skills which will help the company achieve its goals.

  • What do you see yourself doing in the next 5 years

It is a strategic question in which the interviewer wants to know if the direction is clear in the mind of the candidate for their future. The answers should be realistic and should give a good understanding of how the candidate wants to mold their career in the next five years. Individual goals and growth are some of the factors that help to define the mindset of the candidate.

  • Share any conflict which you experienced in your previous work

These questions help to evaluate the candidate based on their problem solving skills and ability to deal with stress and pressure. It is suggested to think before about this question so that the answer can be given with confidence.

  • What is your dream job

By asking such questions, the interviewers want to see how realistic are the goals of the candidate and what planning have they done to achieve it in a specific time frame.

  • Expectations from the team

Such questions analyze the team working capabilities of the candidate and what will be their contribution if they are placed in a team. Such questions should be answered in a way that what type of good will they bring to the team which will help the company overall.

  •  Expectations from the manager

For such questions, the candidate should answer with utmost honesty by even mentioning to any current manager what expectations they have in general. Through this question, they want to know how you will perform as a team member.

  •  Ability to deal with stress

The candidate should express their ability to deal with stress in a positive and productive manner. Having a flexible attitude while dealing with stress will help you overcome the problems easily.

  •  What will be the first month in the position look like for you

Such questions will help the interviewer know how the candidate would perform in the first month, so one should answer by saying that they will use their expertise to the maximum to increase productivity for the company and try to know all their team members.

  •  Salary requirements

Not all companies ask this question but the candidate should give a market competitive amount keeping their prior experience and expertise in mind.

  •  Do you have any questions to ask us

This question is asked to see if the candidate has any confusions or queries with the interview. Candidates can use this as a base to stand out by making a list of relevant questions rather than simply saying no.

title: How to get your opening sales within a month.
excerpt: AMCOB shares proven strategies to help new businesses achieve strong opening sales and lasting market momentum within a month.
lead: AMCOB shares proven strategies to help new businesses achieve strong opening sales and lasting market momentum within a month.
richHtml:
Every entrepreneur is eager to get their first real customer as it is quite special for them. It is indeed a very memorable milestone achieved by entrepreneurs.

Making sure your deal is sealed on the beginning sale requires time and patience. If you rush things and not focus on how to sell your product, you will end up being disappointed very soon. Having numerous marketing channels to promote your business in the market, it is difficult to find the one which makes most sense out of the business and will produce worthwhile results.

Rather than diverting all attention towards making your store look perfect, entrepreneurs should focus on exclusively driving the targeted traffic towards making their purchase.

Why targeted traffic is important for newly opened stores?

Online stores are doing a fine job until they expose their business to the real world. You can’t know what you are improving and where you are lacking unless you expose your business to the world and set a benchmark which can be calculated in numbers and quantity. This is why traffic is extremely important.

It is difficult to find out how interesting your product is if you don’t drive traffic. You won’t even know if your brand resounds with your targeted audience if the traffic is not driven.

To haste up the marketing process, there are some commonly used ecommerce strategies which can enable the business to focus on their efforts to bring traffic.

E-commerce tactics

  1. Offer discount to physical customers: Entrepreneurs can offer discount to people who are directly visiting the store to make a purchase. This way potential customers will also visit the store and are likely to come back if the product fulfills their requirement.
  2. Actions taken online are crucial: It is because they help you to drive the traffic to the store and convince them to make a purchase. Store URLs can be added to the online profile of the business or even on bios mentioned on Twitter or Instagram.
  3. Don’t irritate the audience with repetition of content: Audience gets bored with low quality content and something which is repetitive. Try to provide market authentic content and focus on value propositions. Create engaging content that doesn’t let the audience's interest fade away.
  4. Knock your personal networks: Many entrepreneurs get their first few sales from their personal network or people who believe in them and there is nothing wrong with that. We all support people whom we find genuine. Share about your business on your personal social media accounts to engage a personal network of yours which is comparatively easier to approach. You can even consider emailing your closest connections. It is a good way to get early feedback and introduce your store to your personal connections’ social network.
  5. Being an active part of online communities: Entrepreneurs shouldn’t underestimate the value of talking about your store in various online communities. You never know which platform will provide you the right match for your target audience. Each channel is an opportunity to reach out to the traffic who would find your business interesting. Join groups that target customers and participate actively in them. You can even create authentic connections through such groups and offer them a discount code if they come to purchase anything from the store.
  6. Paying for advertisement: Paying for advertisement is like giving money to gain money in terms of successful sale. Paid advertisement is a wise way to gain targeted traffic. The best fact is that many paid advertisement channels allow you to pay per click. For some platforms, you can start with as low as $10. Each advertisement channel is different and requires a different set of tools and strategy. Hence, you should decide wisely by analyzing your target audience that which platform will be the most suitable for you. Make sure your company’s social media handles are full of posts, because you don’t want your customers to visit a website which doesn’t have enough content of their interest.
  7. Taking help of the bloggers: bloggers are usually in search of fresh content and different stories to talk about. Having a strong pitch based story can help you win a spot on the blog. Or you can even engage those bloggers who would be interested to talk about your product or store.
  8. Building strategic partnerships: Partnerships are a good source of getting your product in front of someone else’s customers. You can partner with companies to arrange contests, package samples of your products or provide discounts on complementary products, you can sponsor an event or even create a product together. You can find like-minded brands who look for healthy competition. This way your product can also come in notice by the customers of the partnered brand.
  9. Work with influencers: you can evaluate your brand requirements and expectations and then look for an influencer who is willing to try and speak well about your product.
  10. Social media marketing: You can use Facebook, Instagram and YouTube to market your products depending on the type of traffic you want to attract.

Gathering traffic is all about joining the dots between the brand and your buyers in a world full of ever-growing opportunities and possibilities. This is what makes marketing so inventive and overwhelming. No approach is considered the best fit for any marketing campaign. As a company you need to experiment with a few approaches to reach your target audience and generate sales.

title: How can value proposition help your business to do better?
excerpt: AMCOB explains how a strong value proposition helps businesses stand out, attract customers, and achieve sustainable growth.
lead: AMCOB explains how a strong value proposition helps businesses stand out, attract customers, and achieve sustainable growth.
richHtml:
Value proposition is something which your business does unique and makes it different from the market. It’s something that your business is best at. It is the reason why your customers are buying the product from you and not from others. Why do people prefer your product with only over a 100 alternatives that are available in the market? What is that special attribute about your product? It is the value proposition that your product is offering to its customers.

If you perfect your value proposition, you can convert your shop visitors into loyal customers. Mastering the art of presentation of the value of the company’s product or services is one of the most wide-reaching marketing tactics. Working on your value proposition will eventually lead to more loyal customers increasing sales for the business.

How can value proposition help a business to establish its name in the market?

A value proposition is the promise made by the company that they will deliver their customers with the best post purchase. It is ultimately something which makes your product attractive in the eyes of the customers. If businesses work on the value proposition, they will make their brand message loud and clear for their customers.

An effective value proposition should have the following three points very crisp.

  • It should be short and specific. You should precisely tell what are the benefits that your customers will be receiving.
  • How can your product provide a solution to fix the problem faced by the customer?
  • You should tell how your product is desirable and special. It should clearly tell the competitive advantage that will set you apart from the competitors.

Brand slogans, catchy advertisements or even brand positioning is different from value proposition.

Your value proposition should mention the special advantage that your customers will get from using the product. It describes how the product can improve the lives of the customers and the way it makes them feel.

How to write a meaningful value proposition?

Firstly, a value proposition should be at the front of the website so that the first thing that visitors see on the page is the value proposition.

  • An effective value proposition uses the voice of the customer’s copy. You can use the exact words of the customers to nail your future customers.

For example, if you surveyed about your product and the terms used by the customers to describe the product or service can be used to form a value proposition. You can even gather other valuable information like how does the product make their life easier? Or how do they describe the company and why do they wish to associate themselves with the company? Using this information to create a value proposition will prove to be very effective. Pay attention to the common words and phrases used by the customers and then tag those in the value proposition for the company.

  • Value proposition should be clear and precise. When you are deciding the value proposition, the following questions should be kept in mind.

What is the product that you are selling?

Who is the target audience for your product?

How can your product improve the life of the customer?

Why should the visitor buy from you and not from other companies?

When exactly will the value be delivered?

It should be of maximum two or three lines and each word should clearly tell why people should buy from you and not from others.

  • Keep your focus on the benefits of the product rather than the hype. If you are using hype to sell your product means that your value proposition is not strong enough. Or maybe the product is also not of great value as it should be.

Identifying and then communicating the value proposition correctly will make businesses flourish and the customers won’t go anywhere leaving the company behind. They will only buy from you and prefer your company over a hundred competitors in the market.

title: Community Management
excerpt: AMCOB emphasizes the power of community management in building engagement, trust, and lasting relationships with audiences.
lead: AMCOB emphasizes the power of community management in building engagement, trust, and lasting relationships with audiences.
richHtml:
Why should a brand continuously engage with its audience?

In today’s era of a highly digital and linked world, at times people feel disconnected from others. With millions of people communicating online, it gets hard to truly connect with others and make sure that the message is communicated efficiently.  Brands need to develop a strong online sense of community and work on its community management.

How can community management be defined?

If you are a relative new person to the social media game, you might not know what community management is. It is defined as how well your brand captures opportunities to interact with its current and future target audience in public online spaces. It is very important these days to develop a strong communication with your target audience to identify what improvements you can make in your product or any other aspect related to it.  Imagine yourself scrolling Facebook and commenting on a brand’s post and then immediately the brand likes your comment and acknowledges it. This helps to create an authentic connection behind a brand by creating a strong bond between its followers and the brand itself. These types of connections spark interest of the audience in that specific brand’s content and online community. This makes the audience feel important as they are heard and acknowledged.

Importance of community management

The main essence of community management is capturing all online opportunities to engage with its audience and to make the online presence of the brand acknowledged by its target audience and other stakeholders. This overall helps to strengthen the online presence of the brand making it more interactive for the audience.  For this purpose, brands need to hire community managers to make sure the interaction is done in a professional way. These managers will create a tone, set a voice and ensure a human element behind a brand. Nobody would be interested in communicating with a robot. So it is very important to make your followers feel that they are communicating with a real human and not a robot with no emotions that they can relate with.

Involve feedback from your customers

Through an online community, your brand gets an insight on customer preferences in terms of content they want to see on the brands page. This helps your brand to understand the audience better and gauge their interest in upcoming products and projects.  Various polls and comments are used as a medium of communication by the brand with its audience.

Offer support to your audience whenever they need it

A great portion of the community management is based on customer support and success. It is very simple to do that. You can use forums, FAQ sections on your brand’s social media pages and many other ways. Through this way your customers can help themselves and many others with communication along with the team members, find resources that they need and review FAQs at any time. On social media, customers often comment when they are facing any problem related to the brand. The brand can clearly see who exactly is contacting them so that they can intervene and provide the best possible assistance to them. This is a great way to resolve issues in real time.

Increasing brand awareness

The more active your brand is online, the more relationships it is able to generate with prospective customers. Brands should use every interaction as an opportunity to better understand the customers and what can the brand do to keep them satisfied and loyal.  This, in return increases brand awareness as you are able to generate a group of followers who have good interest in what your brand is up to. Most importantly, new customers can find out about your brand usually online only. These days the strong online presence of the brand is extremely important.

Engaging with your audience

These are some steps through which you can engage with your audience effectively as a brand;

  • Determine which social media application your audience lives in and then divert your online community managers to that application. 
  • Secondly, define the metrics. Figure out how you will measure success for your online community. Your brand might want more engagement, social mentions, brand sentiment or user-generated content. You might be interested in having more comments and likes as a brand on your content. 

You need to find out the metric first and then direct your strategy towards it. One thing that the brand shouldn’t ignore is the conversation happening on their social media posts.

  • Building a sense of community is a two way process. As much as you post content, you need to keep your target audience active and interactive towards your post. This can be done through user generated content and responding to comments, asking questions on the page and through various polls. You can even go Live on your social media pages to interact with your audience. 
  • Maintaining your brand’s voice and authenticity is essential. You need to have a positive attitude while communicating with the audience. Have a lighter tone and enjoy it with them. 

Community management is comparatively a new, yet impactful industry. By implementing an effective community management strategy, you will be able to create a safe place for your current and potential customers.

title: How a Custom Sports Uniform Business Grew From a Garage to Outfitting 1,100+ Teams Across America
excerpt: Discover how HAMCO Sports grew from a startup to outfitting 1,100+ teams across America. Founder Mark shares 14 years of lessons on scaling a custom sports uniform business, from eliminating minimum orders to mastering sublimation printing and building lasting client relationships.
lead: Discover how HAMCO Sports grew from a startup to outfitting 1,100+ teams across America. Founder Mark shares 14 years of lessons on scaling a custom sports uniform business, from eliminating minimum orders to mastering sublimation printing and building lasting client relationships.
richHtml:
The custom sports apparel industry in the United States is valued at over $20 billion and continues to grow as youth sports participation rises, new leagues emerge, and teams at every level demand professionally designed gear. For entrepreneurs who understand manufacturing, customer relationships, and the power of niche specialization, this industry offers a genuine path to building a sustainable, scalable business.

I founded HAMCO Sports in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for any team — no matter how small — to get high-quality, fully customized uniforms without being forced into massive minimum order quantities. Fourteen years later, we have delivered custom uniforms to over 1,100 teams across the United States and Canada, built lasting partnerships with youth leagues, school athletic programs, and adult recreational organizations, and grown our operation from a small startup into a recognized name in the custom team uniforms market.

This article shares the real lessons, strategies, and challenges behind building a custom sports apparel business — and why I believe this industry still holds significant opportunity for entrepreneurs willing to invest in quality, relationships, and operational excellence.

Identifying the Gap: Why "No Minimum Order" Changed Everything

When I started researching the custom team uniforms space, one frustration came up repeatedly in conversations with coaches, league organizers, and team managers: most manufacturers required minimum orders of 20, 50, or even 100 units. That might work for a large high school program, but it left out thousands of smaller teams — recreational leagues, church groups, startup flag football clubs, small travel basketball squads, and community organizations that only needed 8 to 15 uniforms.

We built our entire business model around eliminating that barrier. At HAMCO Sports, there is no minimum order requirement. A coach can order a single custom basketball jersey or outfit an entire league with custom baseball team uniforms — the quality, pricing, and turnaround remain the same.

This decision shaped everything about how we operate: our production workflow, our vendor relationships, our pricing model, and our customer experience. It also gave us a clear competitive advantage in a market dominated by larger players focused on high-volume institutional contracts.

For entrepreneurs evaluating any industry, the lesson here is universal: look for the friction that established companies are unwilling to remove. That friction is your opening.

Building a Product That Earns Repeat Business

In the custom apparel industry, your product is your reputation. A coach who receives poorly stitched basketball uniforms or a baseball jersey where the sublimation cracks after two washes will never come back — and they will tell every other coach in their league.

From the very beginning, we invested heavily in materials, printing technology, and quality control. Every product we manufacture uses moisture-wicking technology fabrics that keep athletes cool and dry during competition. For sports like basketball and football, where physical intensity is high and comfort directly affects performance, this is not a luxury — it is an expectation.

We specialize in sublimation printing, a process where the ink is heat-transferred directly into the fabric fibers rather than being printed on top. This means the graphics, team logos, player names, and numbers become part of the fabric itself — they will not peel, crack, or fade over time. Whether a customer orders custom sublimated basketball jerseys for a travel team or sublimated football uniforms for a 7-on-7 league, the print quality holds up season after season.

The business lesson here is straightforward: in any product-based business, the quality of what you deliver determines whether you build a one-time transaction or a multi-year client relationship. We have teams that have reordered from us every season for over a decade. That kind of retention is worth far more than any marketing spend.

Expanding Across Sports: A Deliberate Growth Strategy

We did not try to serve every sport from day one. We started with what we knew best — custom basketball uniforms and custom basketball jerseys — and built our reputation in that category first. Basketball was the right starting point because the market is enormous (youth basketball alone has millions of participants in the US), the design possibilities are wide open, and coaches care deeply about basketball jersey design as part of team identity and culture.

Once we established credibility and refined our production processes in basketball, we expanded methodically into adjacent sports. Each expansion was driven by customer demand, not guesswork. Our basketball customers asked if we could make custom baseball jerseys for their spring season. Football coaches in the same leagues wanted custom football uniforms for the fall. That organic demand guided our growth into new product categories.

Today, we manufacture custom uniforms across twelve sports: basketball, baseball, softball, soccer, football, flag football, ice hockey, lacrosse, rugby, volleyball, wrestling, and esports. Each sport has its own design requirements, material specifications, and sizing considerations. Custom flag football jerseys, for example, need to be lightweight and designed for easy movement, while custom american football uniforms require heavier, more durable construction. Baseball uniforms have traditional design elements like piping and button-front options, while fully customizable football uniforms demand reinforced stitching and tackle-twill lettering that can withstand intense physical contact.

For entrepreneurs building a product business, the principle is clear: master one category before expanding. Your existing customer base is the most reliable signal for where to grow next.

The Youth Sports Opportunity

One segment of the market that we have found particularly rewarding — both financially and personally — is youth sports. Youth athletics is a massive ecosystem in the United States. According to the Aspen Institute, approximately 30 million children participate in organized sports each year, and that number has been steadily increasing, particularly in emerging sports like flag football.

Flag football, in particular, has experienced explosive growth. The NFL's push toward flag football as an Olympic-qualifying sport, combined with growing safety concerns around tackle football for younger age groups, has created huge demand for youth flag football jerseys and flag football uniforms. We have worked with dozens of youth flag football leagues and organizations across the country, providing custom flag football jerseys that are built for the speed and agility the game demands.

For business owners evaluating the youth sports market, the key is understanding that your customer is typically not the athlete — it is the parent, the coach, or the league administrator. These are people making purchasing decisions on behalf of groups, often on tight timelines ("our season starts in three weeks") and tight budgets. Your ability to deliver quality product quickly, communicate clearly, and solve problems efficiently is what earns you their trust and their repeat business.

Operations and Fulfillment: Where Most Startups Struggle

The most common mistake I see entrepreneurs make when entering the custom apparel space is underestimating the complexity of operations. Designing a great-looking custom jersey is the easy part. Manufacturing it at consistent quality, fulfilling orders on time, managing sizing across youth and adult ranges, handling customization requests (every player has a different name and number), and shipping to multiple addresses across the country — that is where the real challenge lives.

At HAMCO Sports, we have built our fulfillment process around a 3-to-4-week production and delivery cycle from the point of design approval. This is competitive in the industry, and we achieve it through standardized workflows, strong vendor partnerships, and a team that communicates proactively with customers throughout the process.

We also invested in building custom team stores — online portals where individual players or parents within a team can order their own uniforms, select sizes, and pay directly. This eliminates the logistical nightmare of having a single coach collect money, manage sizes, and coordinate orders for an entire roster. The team store model has been a major operational improvement and a significant value-add for our customers.

Digital Marketing and Customer Acquisition

In the early years, most of our growth came from word-of-mouth referrals. A coach would see another team's uniforms at a tournament, ask who made them, and contact us. That organic referral engine is still our strongest acquisition channel, but as we have scaled, we have complemented it with digital marketing.

Our website, hamcospo.com, serves as both our digital storefront and our primary content marketing platform. We publish content that genuinely helps our target audience: guides on how to measure your team for custom uniforms, breakdowns of different fabric technologies like moisture-wicking technology and sublimation printing, sport-specific design guides for basketball jersey design or baseball uniform customization, and sizing charts for youth through adult.

This content does more than attract traffic — it builds trust. When a coach reads a detailed, knowledgeable article on our site about the differences between sublimated and screen-printed uniforms, they come away believing that we understand their needs. That trust converts browsers into customers far more effectively than any paid advertisement.

For fellow entrepreneurs: content that educates your audience about your industry is one of the highest-ROI marketing investments you can make. It costs time, not dollars, and it compounds over years.

The Importance of Community and Business Networks

Building a business in any niche can be isolating, especially in the early years. One of the most valuable investments I have made — beyond equipment, inventory, or marketing — is investing in business community and peer networks.

Organizations like AMCOB provide exactly the kind of environment that entrepreneurs need: a community of peers who understand the challenges of building and scaling a business, who can share practical advice from their own experience, and who hold you accountable to the goals you set. The peer advisory model, where business owners meet regularly to discuss challenges and strategies in a confidential, trust-based setting, has been instrumental in helping me think more clearly about growth decisions, operational bottlenecks, and long-term strategic planning.

Whether you are manufacturing custom baseball jerseys, building a tech startup, or running a professional services firm, the fundamental challenges of entrepreneurship — hiring, cash flow management, customer acquisition, scaling operations — are remarkably similar. Surrounding yourself with people who have solved these problems in their own contexts gives you a significant advantage.

Lessons for Entrepreneurs Considering the Custom Apparel Industry

If the custom sports uniform industry interests you, here are the most important things I have learned over 14 years:

Start with one niche and dominate it. We started with custom basketball uniforms. We became known for quality basketball jersey design before expanding into other sports. Trying to serve every market from day one spreads your resources too thin and prevents you from building a reputation in any single category.

Quality is non-negotiable. In a market where coaches talk to each other constantly, one bad batch of uniforms can damage your reputation for years. Invest in premium materials, reliable printing technology, and rigorous quality control from the start.

Solve a real problem. Our no-minimum-order policy was not a marketing gimmick — it solved a genuine pain point that thousands of small teams experienced. Find the equivalent problem in your market and build your business around solving it.

Build for retention, not just acquisition. Acquiring a new customer in custom team uniforms costs far more than retaining an existing one. Our best customers have been reordering for 10+ years. Every interaction — from initial quote to final delivery — should be designed to earn the next order.

Invest in relationships. The custom uniform business is fundamentally a relationship business. Coaches and league organizers want to work with people they trust. Be responsive, be honest about timelines, and deliver on your promises.

Embrace digital, but do not abandon personal touch. Our website and content marketing drive awareness, but our phone calls, personal emails, and one-on-one design consultations close the deals. Technology enables scale, but human connection builds loyalty.

Looking Ahead: Where the Industry Is Headed

The custom sports apparel market is being shaped by several major trends that entrepreneurs should watch.

The growth of flag football — now an Olympic-qualifying sport — is creating massive new demand for flag football uniforms and flag football jerseys at the youth, high school, and adult levels. Esports is another rapidly expanding category, with teams and organizations wanting custom sublimated jerseys that look professional during streaming and in-person events.

On the technology side, advances in sublimation printing are enabling more intricate basketball jersey design, more vibrant color reproduction, and faster production times. Fabric technology continues to improve as well, with next-generation moisture-wicking technology that is lighter, more breathable, and more environmentally sustainable.

The shift toward direct-to-consumer and custom team store models is also accelerating. Teams no longer want to deal with paper order forms and manual size collection. They expect a digital ordering experience that is easy, fast, and professional. Businesses that invest in this infrastructure now will have a significant competitive advantage going forward.

Final Thoughts

Building HAMCO Sports from a startup into a company that has outfitted over 1,100 teams with custom uniforms has been the most challenging and rewarding journey of my professional life. The custom sports apparel industry rewards entrepreneurs who combine product quality, operational discipline, genuine customer relationships, and a willingness to adapt as the market evolves.

If you are an entrepreneur looking for an industry with real demand, strong repeat-purchase dynamics, and room for differentiated players who prioritize quality over volume, the custom team uniforms space deserves a serious look.

And if your team needs custom basketball jerseys, custom baseball team uniforms, custom flag football jerseys, or fully customizable football uniforms — you know where to find us.

About the Author: Mark is the founder of HAMCO Sports Inc. (hamcospo.com), a custom sports uniform manufacturer based in the United States that has served over 1,100 teams since 2011. HAMCO Sports specializes in sublimation-printed, fully customizable uniforms across 12 sports with no minimum order requirements. Connect with HAMCO Sports at hamcospo.com or call 845-234-6113.

title: How can job rotation be helpful for the company?
excerpt: AMCOB explains how job rotation boosts employee skills, engagement, and productivity while strengthening overall company performance.
lead: AMCOB explains how job rotation boosts employee skills, engagement, and productivity while strengthening overall company performance.
richHtml:
Job rotation is when you rotate employees vertically between two or more tasks, at regular intervals to give them more exposure and find out their expertise. It’s a technical test, in other words, where the employee is put into various assignments to judge their competencies and skill set that they possess until they are finally assigned the right place and designation matching their capabilities. This is usually done for entry level employees or employees who are potentially capable of promotion. It increases the worth of the employee within the organization and provides exposure to various vertical assignments which enhances the skill set of the employee. This is also considered as in-house training of the employee. It is really good for the employee personally as well as they can explore where their interest lies and in what area they can work the best to take the company to new heights.

Job rotation is supported by the HR department

Human Resource departments of any organization fully extend their support to job rotation because of these reasons. It helps the company find the best fit candidate for the position that has been vacant. Job rotation helps to allocate the right person at the right place with no wastage of time. Job rotation increases the employee horizons by providing them an opportunity to vertically explore all areas and deciding where their best interest lies. Job rotation is quite motivating as it reduces the monotony of the job as employees are shifted regularly and give mass exposure. It helps the employees to look forward to each new day and provide more learning opportunities and confidence. Job rotation is one of the best ways to check the skills and capabilities of the employees and how they are able to survive and keep the best foot forward towards taking the company to the next level!

How is Job rotation beneficial?

Job rotation is absolutely the best way to reduce boredom for the employees which is generally caused by the same monotonous work and routine. It helps to revitalize the excitement and energy level of the employees. The employees are exposed to amazing knowledge, which enhances personal and professional growth. It provides the employees with new opportunities increasing their learning at work. It boots job satisfaction and they develop a strong sense of belonging towards the organization. It enhances the career growth opportunities for potential candidates. This can also be considered as a training to those employees who are being considered to make the team head or their promotion is in line. It greatly enhances the career growth opportunities for the employees and makes them more efficient towards their work. Due to job rotation, employees get to interact with various employees leading to better understanding among team members and more confidence gained by the employees. Thus, having a well-planned and well-defined job rotation plan can be very helpful for an organization as it helps to increase the satisfaction level of employees, their growth opportunities will be vast which will lead to more employee engagement. Companies will be able to retain employees and work towards overall development of the employees.

title: Being present everywhere is not a good idea for Entrepreneurs
excerpt: AMCOB advises entrepreneurs to focus on quality over presence, strategic focus drives growth better than being everywhere.
lead: AMCOB advises entrepreneurs to focus on quality over presence, strategic focus drives growth better than being everywhere.
richHtml:
Generally, it has been heard and said that businesses should ensure its presence everywhere. However, it is a completely bad idea to have your presence at all platforms.

One of the biggest challenges that entrepreneurs face is choosing the right marketing strategy and the channel to reach its target customers. The potential and target customers use a certain platform to look for the desired product, therefore wasting resources to be present at all platforms will only affect the business undesirably.

Without this basic clarity and focus on the marketing approach, it is highly impossible to reach the business drive. Having a sharp focus and then directing all the resources towards its achievement is what entrepreneurs should work on. Deciding which marketing strategies to focus on and which ones to pass on is a crucial decision. Following are some steps that can be followed to achieve clarity in decision making:

  1. Be aware of your strengths

It sounds easy to know what you are good at, but it is very difficult to determine it. Entrepreneurs should find their competitive advantage because that is their real strength. Once you know your strength, you know how your business will stand out and the right strategy can be planned. Energy of the business should be invested in making 2,3 most relevant strategies work for you. Focusing energy to numerous strategies will only lead to wastage of resources.

We breathe in a society where we are asked to focus on improving the weaknesses. However, it should be an 80-20 division of efforts. 80% efforts should be utilized for further enhancing the strengths and 20% of the effort and resources should be used towards improving the weaknesses.

Invest in your maker strengths and deliver such a sideral customer experience and showcase the best of your work to ask for referrals. Make your marketing language a creative tool to pave way in the industry.

  1. Determining what you need to say No to

You need to prioritize goals of the business in a proper timeline and make sure which opportunities are worthy of saying yes. Not all collaborations and fancy offers need to be brought into consideration. Only a few well-meaning ones are to be given importance keeping in mind where you want to see your business.

  1. Investing time and energy to big goals 

Make sure you know where you want to see your business in the next 5 years, 10 years and next 25 years. If the planning and thinking is strategic, then only you can allocate resources accordingly.

Marketing energies should be invested in finding bigger platforms to build your own via interviews, stage speaking and contributing to major websites.

Too often, entrepreneurs are caught up with what others are doing and trying to replicate the same for their business. This is wrong as the whole time is being wasted in copying others and trying to make something work for your business which in real won’t do any miracle.

Successful entrepreneurs keep their marketing technique strategic and simple because staying consistent on the right track will lead to long term success.

Entrepreneurs should focus on bigger goals they have for their business and do intense market research before directing its resources towards the fulfillment of the respective goal.

title: How can recruitment marketing help you get the best talent on board?
excerpt: AMCOB explains how recruitment marketing attracts top talent by building employer brand visibility and engaging the right candidates.

By creating meaningful content, companies engage potential candidates which leads to the increase in talent pipeline as they come to be associated with the brand positively. The goal of the content comprises of telling a good story that will leave job hunters with meaningful and extraordinary impression of the company.

However, in times of high unemployment, companies are still having a difficult time finding qualified candidates to fill various jobs. Many employers are now turning to recruitment marketing strategy to attract the right candidate for the right position. Unlike the basic traditional career postings made by the companies which mainly describe job positions, it is better to work on recruitment marketing strategy which will include many inspirational stories which can humanize your brand. There are different channels which are used under recruitment marketing to promote job postings. It is a proactive approach which mainly focuses on attracting and obtaining the best talent through high levels of enthusiast engagement and sharing online rather than just casually sitting back and waiting for a large submission of common applicants.

Many organizations have come to this conclusion that recruitment marketing practice works best for them. These firms’ best recruiting practices may inspire you to imitate them, or can also help to generate some new ideas of your own. The real key is to keep the learning process continued about online recruiting style, figuring out what works best for the brand and then formulating strategies to fit the corporate culture.

Aspects of Recruitment Marketing 

To attract the best talent and engage them, and to get the right message circulated in front of the right audience at the perfect time. These are the factors that can prove to be very interactive, utilize multichannel approach and build relationships with the right candidates and achieve measurable results.
